candidate_rules: new quality_p1; previous P0 rules and results retained
S1_policy: exclude only clear_issue; retain review_needed and no_supported_issue_found; unchanged original targets
checkpoint_selection: Choose lowest development answer/EOS-token loss separately for each arm; earlier epoch breaks exact ties. Development source-consistency probes are descriptive only and cannot change the candidate, checkpoint rule or final test.
training_hyperparameters: shared P1 SFT candidate configuration; source/length/feature matching; report actual token and runtime differences

quality_validation.readiness_for_controlled_experiment: Prespecified engineering/data-policy study: no more than 1/30 synthetic controls falsely clear-flagged; no more than 1 observed false clear-flag in 30 source-reviewed real targets; at least 512 eligible unique groups per arm; all omissions/unknowns reported. This gate authorizes studying the policy, not labeling unflagged data clinically correct.
quality_validation.on_failure: Retain failures; do not tune on these validation outputs or claim readiness. A further version needs new validation.

final_sampling.selection: source-only, unique text group, exclude all registered historical hashes/families and possible fragment parents, seeded sample then seeded order
final_sampling.limitations: Stratified diagnostic sample; all eight 1000+ character reports are from BIMCV, so length and source effects cannot be separated. Patient and pretraining independence unknown.

status_priority: source_error > incomplete > unjudgeable > pass; preserve orthogonal completeness/precision/readability flags
required_facts: Record source facts/evidence before viewing any generated output, including polarity, location, quantity roles, temporal/uncertainty relations and source recommendations. Redundant wording and identifiers are not mandatory; acquisition details only required if they limit interpretation. Preserve source ambiguities as unresolved; do not invent gold medical judgments.
final_review: All 120 outputs source-compared, model names hidden during review where feasible; same source facts for all arms; no manual target rewriting or post-final tuning.
statistics: Paired report-level counts and bootstrap differences with seed3710261117, 2000 resamples; Wilson intervals for pass proportions; not clinical accuracy or patient comprehension.
training_resume: fresh runs only; saved epoch adapters are not exact optimizer/RNG resume
failures: All frozen reports remain in denominators; token limit, runtime error and uncertain review reported separately. No selection by favorable final outcome.
